events.title: Appulse will launch on November 26th!
events.summary: We’ve shared the most exciting news at the Galaxies Autumn Showcase: Appulse will release on November 26th! Additionally, we’ll participate in the Steam Next Fest, starting on October 19th, with an updated demo. Whether you are a veteran or a newbie, you won’t want to miss it what it will include: New weapon available to unlock, the Boson Gun. New special ability available to unlock, the Dash. New enemy might appear during your expeditions. Rework skilltree visuals Improve UI and User experience

events.title: Dev Log: The Music of Appulse
events.summary: Attention recruits! We’re taking a look at the music of Appulse, the inspirations and how the music is used to enhance the atmosphere of the game. How would you describe the music of Appulse? The OST of Appulse reflects what is happening in game, it is above all electrical and very energic but also evolves to calmer tones when the pace slows down. It can be atmospheric, mysterious, dynamic, profound and aggressive. This is what makes it unique, the variety of styles and tunes you can find in it.
